title: reset
description: The subscription is over; nothing was silently lost. slow_consumer: after readiness re-attach with the cursor, before it re-attach when: ready with none. omitted and replay_failed: re-attach with no cursor. session_replaced: the host closes the connection; reconnect, hello afresh (the token is void) and attach the new session. session_closed: the session is over, its final records delivered; the host closes the connection.
